thread.title: Technology Sector Update for 11/15/2018: RVLT, NTES, CSCO, MSFT, AAPL, IBM, GOOG

author: MT Newswires
title: Technology Sector Update for 11/15/2018: RVLT, NTES, CSCO, MSFT, AAPL, IBM, GOOG
text:
Shutterstock photo Top Technology Stocks:
MSFT: +0.03%
AAPL: +0.89%
IBM: +0.16%
CSCO: +4.90%
GOOG: Flat
Tech stocks were mostly inger in pre-bell trading Thursday.
Early movers include:
(-) Revolution Lighting Technologies ( RVLT ), which was declining by more than 10% after it received a revised proposal from RVL I LLC, an affiliate of the company's chairman and CEO, Robert V. LaPenta, to acquire all of the outstanding common stock of the company, which lowers the initial offer to $1.50 per share from $2.00 per share.
(+) NetEase ( NTES ) was over 4% higher as it released its Q3 results, with non-GAAP diluted earnings slipping to $2.55 per American Depositary Share from $3.32 a year ago, still beating the $2.51 mean from analysts polled by CapIQ.
(+) Cisco ( CSCO ) was up by more than 4% after it reported Q1 earnings of $0.75 per share on a non-GAAP basis, up from $0.61 per share a year ago and better than the analyst consensus of $0.72 per share on Capital IQ. Revenue was $13.1 billion, up 8% from the $12.1 billion posted last year and ahead of expectations of $12.86 billion.
